Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman.

a fair porcelain complexion with a cool undertone, early 20s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, top bun chocolate brown hair — wearing a skin-tight ultra-high-cut micro swimsuit of ultra-thin glossy cherry-red latex, made of two small triangle cups held by a single narrow V-shaped strap of the same latex that comes down from behind her neck, passes over both cups and runs straight down the center of her stomach to merge into the front of the bottom, a short closed zipper running down the center of the strap with the zipper teeth visible, her waist sides, her flanks, her stomach and the skin around the straps bare, the bottom is only a small triangle at the front cut extremely high up to the very top of her hip bones, her hips, thighs and legs completely bare, the latex shrink-wrapped onto her body like a second skin, fully opaque, her arms bare, her face and hands bare. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, a small mole near her collarbone and a small beauty mark near her lips. The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin latex molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, the dip of her navel, her ribs, her hip bones and the roundness of her bust and hips, the V strap pressing lightly into her skin, the zipper teeth glinting down the center, fine pull-creases and a deep mirror shine. Background: a real famous place photographed at true scale, Paris with the Eiffel Tower, the River Seine with its stone bridges and rows of cream stone buildings placed in the foreground close to the camera at the bottom centre of the frame, rising only to the height of her waist and thighs, tiny tourists, tiny cars and tiny tour buses around its base at their real size appearing as small as ants; she is a colossal giant standing just behind and slightly to one side of the foreground landmark, so that it overlaps only part of her legs and clearly shows how much taller than it she is, her towering heels planted on the riverside avenues, a soft golden-hour sky behind her, the whole place clearly visible and in focus, lit by warm golden-hour sunlight with gentle shadows. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at knee height, the famous foreground landmark large at the bottom centre of the frame and she standing just behind it, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the real people, vehicles and trees around her ankles shown at their true size so her colossal height and the extreme heel height read at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor.
